{{Top|leg}}
[[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] maintained a '''prothium refining station''' 40,000 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] above the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Killaniri]]. It deployed [[gas collector]]s to collect [[prothium]] that could be used as a [[Blaster gas/Legends|blaster gas]].
